description: YOLO26s baseline. COCO-pretrained, imgsz 1280, Ultralytics default hyperparameters.
YOLO26s, sequence-level 80/20 split (all 3 videos in train), F2 fitness, early stop after 25 epochs without F2 gain.
c02 + augmentation changes (no HSV, rotation 10, both flips, mixup 0.15, scale 0.2) and a 45-epoch schedule.
c03 at imgsz 1920 (1.5x upscale of the 1280x720 frames), batch 4 to fit memory. Tests whether resolution helps.
2.85x upscale (1st place's 3648 px) via 449x253 crops trained at 1280 with rect; full-frame val and inference at 3648. c04's augmentation otherwise.

Fine-tune c05 best.pt on a 3x2 overlapping grid of 493x493 tiles at imgsz 1408 (2.856x), sliver tiles dropped, 25% empty tiles, square training with mosaic 0.25, mixup 0.25 and exact rot90. Full-frame val at 3648.
c06 with 50% empty grid tiles (was 25%) to cut c06's false alarms on empty frames (213 vs c04's 137), and a 12-epoch schedule since c06 peaked at epoch 6 of 20.
YOLO26m from COCO on c06's data and augmentation (3x2 grid of 493x493 tiles at imgsz 1408, 2.856x; sliver tiles dropped; 25% empty; mosaic 0.25, mixup 0.25, rot90). 50 epochs. Full-frame val at 3648.
